column1: # Klondike Draw 3 after replacing the no-op FoundationRollback rule with FoundationRollbackNeedsReceiver: a foundation -> tableau rollback is only explored when a visible card of rank-1 and opposite color (face-up in another column or the current waste card) could be placed on it; aces never return. Previously 26-52% of expanded nodes in the first chunk were foundation -> column moves that the old rule never pruned. Same node budget
# Result: 500 games; 343 wins (68.60%); 157 stalled; 0 timeouts; average duration 6.97 s. Previous internal Draw 3 reference was ~65%.
